newsitem.title: FRANCE: Petrol bombs target French gendarmerie.
newsitem.headline: Petrol bombs target French gendarmerie.

text.p: Unidentified attackers hurled two petrol bombs at paramilitary gendarmerie barracks in the French Basque village of Saint-Pee-sur-Nivelle overnight, police said on Saturday.
A gendarmerie car was destroyed and two others were damaged by the fire. There were no injuries.
There was no immediate claim for the drive-by attack. A Basque separatist guerrilla group, Iparretarak (Those of the North), has been sporadically active in the region.
